WCAG 2.2 Level A dan AA menjadi kriteria: WCAG 2.2 Levels A and AA serve as the acceptance criteria for a website’s structure, content, components, navigation, and interactions. Automated testing serves only as a preflight check; keyboard access, screen readers, contrast, zoom, reflow, and real devices still need to be reviewed.
Menghormati prefers-reduced-motion, mend: Respects the `prefers-reduced-motion` property, supports text scaling up to 200%, and targets reflow at a width of 320 CSS px without losing functionality.
Fokus harus terlihat dan tidak tertutup: The focus must be visible and not obscured by fixed content. The minimum target size is 24 × 24 CSS px, in accordance with SC 2.5.8 and its exceptions; this design prioritizes 44 CSS px.
Konten harus tetap terbaca saat pengguna: Content must remain readable when users adjust line height, paragraph spacing, font size, and word spacing in accordance with SC 1.4.12.

Halaman sejarah sekolah menyebut bahwa p: The school’s history page states that initially there were 22 classrooms, one shared workshop, one computer lab, a teachers’ lounge, two restrooms, and a prayer room. During the 2004–2012 construction period, the publication notes that the school expanded to include 26 classrooms, three computer labs, six practical workshops, an auditorium, restrooms for students and teachers, and other supporting facilities.
Publikasi sejarah juga menyebut pembangu: Historical publications also mention the construction of the gate and fence during the 2011–2012 school year, as well as the installation of internet and Wi-Fi networks. All of this information is part of the historical record as documented in school sources; it does not confirm that these numbers and conditions remain the same today.
Publikasi fasilitas 2022 memuat sembilan: The 2022 facility publication includes nine photographs labeled with the filenames. The content of the photographs has not been reviewed individually; these labels do not confirm the inventory, number of units, room functions, or current condition of the facilities.

Teks normal menargetkan 4.5:1, teks besa: Normal text should aim for a 4.5:1 ratio, large text for a 3:1 ratio, and component borders or informational graphics for a 3:1 ratio. Each theme and state must still be tested.
Menu dan konten tambahan tidak boleh ber: Menus and additional content must not rely solely on hover; they must be accessible via the keyboard, closable, and remain available when the pointer moves away.
Fitur saat ini tidak memakai drag-and-dr: The current version does not use drag-and-drop, login, or multi-step forms. If those features are added, alternatives to dragging, as well as data entry and authentication criteria, will become the gateway to acceptance.
